response.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` > '1995-11-09' AND `Examination Date` < '1997-03-17';

assumptions.assumption: Examination Date values are stored as ISO-8601 text (YYYY-MM-DD), so text comparison matches chronological order and the bounds are exclusive as requested. AVG skips NULL ANA values, and COUNT(*) counts every record in the range, including those with NULL ANA.
